headline: US Employers Shift Rising Healthcare Premiums Onto Employees
summary: Surveys indicate US employers are shifting rising healthcare expenses onto workers through higher deductibles and premiums, compounding household pressure from elevated food and gasoline costs.
why: Employee benefits and healthcare costs represent one of the largest corporate overhead expenses and directly impact consumer disposable income.

impacts.name: US Consumer Discretionary
impacts.why: Higher healthcare deductions constrain discretionary household spending capacity.
